text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While taking a walk along the perimeter for a breather—

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mmm~? Where could it have gone?
Rice-chan's ribbon!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I-It's okay, Urara-chan...!
We can just buy a new one...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: "Still, it was your favorite, right? If it's your favorite, that means it's super important to you!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: I absolutely have to find it!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Urara-chan...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Don't worry, I'll definitely find it!
Ehehe!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, nope, not here.
Where could it be~?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After I joined them and the three of us split up to search,
rain began to fall, pattering drop by drop.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"After I joined up and the three of us split up to search,
rain began to fall, drop by drop."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rain...!? I-Is it Rice's fault...!?
I'm, so sorry...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm fine now, Urara-chan...!
I'm sorry for causing you trouble...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Why!? What happened!?
I can keep going, you know!? Right, Trainer!
choice_data_list: Let's hold out a bit longer!
Let's head back to the academy for now.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Mhm-mhm, exactly!
It's way too early to give up!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: B-But...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—However, after a while,
the rain began to pick up...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Phew,
I'm so glad we found the ribbon!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, everyone was completely soaking wet.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I-I'm sorry... It's all Rice's fault...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Why is it Rice-chan's fault?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: "B-Because me losing my ribbon, and the rain pouring down... it's all Rice's fault..."

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? Rice-chan, can you
make it rain!?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"Awesome! I just love splish-splashing
around in the rain~!"

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
That rain was all thanks to you too, Rice-chan!
Thank you, Rice-chan!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: N-N-No, you've got it wrong, Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Afterward, the misunderstanding was cleared up, and Rice Shower's tense expression completely softened thanks to Haru Urara.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh!? You're definitely gonna be found right away!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Even if it rains, I'm having fun so it's fine!!
More importantly, I gotta find my precious ribbon!!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Urara-chan, if you get soaked in the rain,
you'll catch a cold...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I don't want Urara-chan
to catch a cold...

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
"...Uuu, alright, as soon as the rain stops,
let's go look for it right away! Promise!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The next day, since the rain had stopped, I went to look for them,
only to find that Haru Urara and the others were already there.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Found the ribbon over there~!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...! Thank you! Urara-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having apparently gone out looking since early morning,
her deep care for her friend was evident.
